bullish.ema_position: price above 50 EMA and 50 EMA above 200 EMA (golden cross structure)
bullish.market_structure: higher highs and higher lows, bullish break of structure (BOS)

bearish.ema_position: price below 50 EMA and 50 EMA below 200 EMA (death cross structure)
bearish.market_structure: lower highs and lower lows, bearish break of structure (BOS)

neutral.ema_position: price oscillating around 50 EMA or EMAs converging

risk_rules.stop_loss_placement: below/above recent swing low/high or key structure level
risk_rules.position_sizing: risk amount / (entry price - stop loss price)

Volume.purpose: confirm breakouts and trend strength; look for above-average volume on directional moves
